title: Northgate Marketplace Order Cancellation Policy
content:
**Policy.** A buyer of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee may ask to cancel only while the order is in placed status. The request is recorded as a cancellation request and passed to the seller, who must accept or decline it within the program's seller cancellation response time in business days; an order the seller has already shipped is no longer canceled but returned under the return rules. An order not shipped within the program's late-shipment cancellation business days after its handling deadline may be canceled at the buyer's request without the seller's acceptance, and a seller who cannot fulfil cancels on its own. A canceled order refunds every line and the shipping charge in full under the program's cancellation refund basis to the original payment. The statuses open to a cancellation request are those the program lists.

**Eligibility.** The condition is a state of the system record, read before any action: the order's status on the marketplace order record of the very order the request names must be placed. A buyer's statement that an order has not left does not replace that record.

**Status test.**

| Order status on the record | May the buyer ask to cancel? |
|---|---|
| placed | yes |
| shipped, delivered, canceled or refunded | no |

**Hypothetical illustration.** An order whose record shows shipped is not canceled; it is returned under the return rules. An order still placed three business days past its handling deadline under a program whose late-shipment figure is 3 is still within the seller's acceptance; one placed beyond that may be canceled at the buyer's request without it.
